title: Optional result via pointer
prompt: Implement `const int* max_of(const int* a, const int* b)`: return a pointer to the larger int; if both are null return nullptr; if one is null return the other's pointer.
boilerplate:
#include <iostream>

const int* max_of(const int* a, const int* b);

tests.name: both
tests.hint: Return the address of the larger, not a copy.

tests.name: one-null
tests.hint: One side missing → the other wins.

tests.name: none
tests.hint: No objects → nullptr is the honest answer.
